hooks.name: Chat tests on save
hooks.description: Runs the assistant unit tests (guard, ids, prompt, Claude loop with a fake client, route, panel helpers) whenever a chat file or its tests are saved.

hooks.name: Engine-chat contract on guard change
hooks.description: When the guard, ids, prompt or fallback change, re-runs the cross-team contract: the fallback text for all 94 engine cases and random records must pass the guard.

hooks.name: Chat guardrails before tasks
hooks.description: Before a spec task runs, reminds the agent of the chat's safety, cost and ownership rules.

action.prompt: If this task belongs to .kiro/specs/assistant-chat/: (1) Never loosen the output guard to make a reply pass; every new guard rule needs a passing and a blocked unit-test sentence, and fallbackText must still pass the guard. (2) No paid Claude API call or eval run unless the task asks for it; never print or log ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or any record, question or reply text. (3) Edit only src/app/api/assistant/, src/components/assistant/, tests/unit/assistant/, tests/e2e/assistant.spec.ts and scripts/eval-assistant.ts; never src/domain/diagnosis/. (4) If a requirement conflicts with what the API or the code allows, stop and report the conflict with options instead of picking one.
